svg.text: Sub-tabs in Tungsten's own style — proposal for approval (round P0b)
Example: the script viewer's tab with four sub-tabs. Colours, radii and sizes are Tungsten's theme values.
no fill · TextDim icon and text
SurfaceHover fill · Text icon and text
• Pills 26 px tall, corner 6 (same as title-bar buttons)
• Strip on a Chrome band 38 px, like the path bar
• Open sub-tab: the side bar's AccentSoft + Accent icon
• Hover: SurfaceHover, like the side-bar tabs
• Icon + text; optional badge (new: tabs:Badge(id, n))
• Underline removed; plugins still can't restyle it
• Too many to fit: the strip scrolls sideways (wheel)
